existing_rationale: Mesothelioma in situ was introduced in the WHO Thoracic volume primarily as a preinvasive pleural lesion, but peritoneal in-situ mesothelioma is increasingly recognized; the evidence does not cleanly restrict it to a single proper subset of the pleura/pericardium/peritoneum ceiling.

Reports suggest CIC::NUTM1 has a distinct tropism for the axial skeleton and, in the CNS literature, is the most common CIC fusion partner in intracranial tumors; the site data are conflicting and based on very few cases, so a proper-subset restriction cannot be established with confidence.
